in_arabic.name: سبحان
in_arabic.meaning: الله تعالیٰ کی پاکی و مناعت کا اظہار
in_arabic.long_meaning: سبحان اللہ کی پاکی و مناعت کا اظہار، جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی عظمت و بزرگی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات و اسماء حسنیٰ میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_urdu.name: سبحانن
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی پاکی و مناعت کا اظہار کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: سبحانن اللہ تعالیٰ کی پاکی و مناعت کا اظہار کرنے کا مطلب ہے، جو اللہ کی عظمت و بزرگی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے اور اکثر والدین اپنے بچوں کو یہ نام دینے کی کوشش کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: सुब्हानुन
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की पवित्रता और महानता का प्रदर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुब्हानुन का अर्थ है भगवान की पवित्रता और महानता का प्रदर्शन करना, जो भगवान की महिमा और श्रेष्ठता को प्रकट करता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर माता-पिता अपने बच्चों को यह नाम देने का प्रयास करते हैं।

data.cultural_impact: The phrase ‘Subhaanun Allahi Wa Bihamdihi’ is an important part of daily prayers in Islam. Muslims utter it repeatedly as a remembrance of Allah and to seek His forgiveness and blessings. The use of this phrase signifies the reverence and awe Muslims have towards Allah, emphasizing the importance of monotheism in Islamic teachings. These moral values are deeply rooted in Islamic culture and are reflected in various aspects of the daily life, from prayer routines to interpersonal relationships and societal norms.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the phrase ‘Subhaanun Allahi Wa Bihamdihi’ serves as a constant reminder of the infinite greatness and oneness of God. Muslims believe that the repetition of this phrase helps to purify their hearts, focusing their thoughts solely on Allah, and enabling them to connect with Him on a deeper level. The phrase acts as a form of protection against Satan's whispers and initiates the process of seeking Allah's forgiveness and guidance. Hence, the concept of Subhaanun Allahi Wa Bihamdihi holds immense spiritual significance as it encourages self-reflection, fosters a sense of humility and gratitude, and reinforces the faith of Muslims in the unity and oneness of God.
